system.description:
FORCE INVESTED INVOCATION

Usage any weapon; Activate Command (1 AP)

The Soulful Strike Rune is engraved with calming mantras and symbols of inner strength.

When active, the weapon inflicts secondary force damage based upon its level.

SOULFUL I

Level 7; Price 2,100 gp

The weapon inflicts 1d6 damage.

On the sheet: Press Soulful Strike on the weapon (Command, 1 AP) to switch it on or off, as an energy rune: while on, a hit adds the tier's force damage, and at II and III a critical adds its secondary force critical (B9-2: severity −3 and −1 read as the energy runes' −40 and −20).
